So essentially you have a 1 and a half hour window to schedule your GP appointments on that day. And there is no scheduling ahead. It's insane.
Then to really cement the experience the staff have made multiple mistakes on the two appointments and follow ups. Once for a blood routine they scheduled incorrectly so when arriving at the hospital for my scheduled appointment I had to wait for hours while the GP sorted it out. The hospital lab doing the blood work told me the manner in which the GP had incorrectly scheduled the appointment and when I told the office staff of this procedural routine and simply asked that they should note this in their protocols....... I was either ignored (email) or was responded to indignantly over the phone. Every call we made to the office felt like we were being an inconvenience and a bother and "wouldn't you please just use the app".  Even though it's not actually an app. And it's terrible. And it's impossible to schedule.
Sigh. I wish others better luck.",null,[0,238]]]],[null,1648804523000000,1648804666000000,"3 years ago",null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/8534161343672408878/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUlhjbU15YVcxUlJSQUIQAA%3D%3D",[null,null,null,"/local/business/8534161343672408878/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUlhjbU15YVcxUlJSQUIQAA%3D%3D"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/8534161343672408878/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUlhjbU15YVcxUlJSQUIQAA%3D%3D",[null,null,null,"/local/business/8534161343672408878/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUlhjbU15YVcxUlJSQUIQAA%3D%3D"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/8534161343672408878/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUlhjbU15YVcxUlJSQUIQAA%3D%3D",[null,null,null,"/local/business/8534161343672408878/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVUlhjbU15YVcxUlJSQUIQAA%3D%3D"],null,["en"],[["Dear John
